description: OTAWA static WCET targets for profiler_demo on STM32G070RB

timing.clock_notes: SystemClock_Config: HSI16, PLL off, AHB/APB prescaler 1, FLASH_LATENCY_0. Profiler timer runs at 16 MHz (1 tick = 1 CPU cycle).

instrumentation.notes: Benchmark functions have no instrumented child calls, and the profiler subtracts the outer hook overhead from recorded durations. Exclude the hooks via nocall so static WCET matches measured function execution.

loops.reason: Instrumented build: loop counts down from count = 25 to 0.
Instrumented build: inner bit loop runs 8 iterations per byte.
Instrumented build: outer byte loop runs 16 iterations over 16-byte buffer.
